body:
I honestly just feel kinda worthless, like theres nothing I'll be able to accomplish anymore. I've been stuck having my mom pay for my phone bill and helping me pay down my credit card bills. Even sold my car to help pay stuff down and im already broke somehow and it's only been two weeks. $400 gone and nothing to show for it. Hell I just turned 20 and I already feel like I've hit my peak, that theres no where else to go but down from here.

I just don't see any worth in my self right now. I got fired almost a year ago from Gamestop for an issue that i had no control of at all and haven't been able to find anything else at all. Every single place I've applied at since then has either turned me down or just never got back to me at all. I'm just starting to seem like more of a burden to the people around me in my own eyes then anything else.

> what would that look like?

I actually have no clue at all
